title: An optional user claim through the dev-stub `x-dev-claims` header — carried onto `currentUser` when present, and absent (a principal LACKING it) when omitted, on every backend

authzLadder.//: Neither harness principal carries `customerId` or `regions`, so BOTH lack the optional claims and every gate that reads them refuses both: the authorized arm is a 403 here on purpose — a backend that let an absent optional claim fall back to a built-in value would admit it.  The admitted side (a principal that carries the claims) is the fixture's own `test e2e`.

gated.label: an equality gate on an optional claim the caller lacks
a presence gate on an optional string claim the caller lacks
a presence gate on an optional list claim the caller lacks

authzLadder.anonymousNote: dev-stub verifier accepts every request — no anonymous caller exists
